dashboard.label: LeRobot SO-101 Telemetry
dashboard.description: Real-time telemetry from LeRobot SO-101 robot arm via ROS2 → Splunk HEC

search.query: index=lerobot_telemetry sourcetype=lerobot:telemetry event_type=robot_step | table _time episode step shoulder_pan shoulder_lift elbow_flex wrist_flex wrist_roll gripper | sort -_time | head 1
index=lerobot_telemetry sourcetype=lerobot:telemetry event_type=robot_step | stats avg(policy_fps) as avg_fps avg(inference_latency_ms) as avg_latency by episode | sort -avg_fps
index=lerobot_telemetry sourcetype=lerobot:telemetry event_type=system_stats | timechart span=30s avg(cpu_percent) as CPU avg(gpu_util_percent) as GPU_P95

index=lerobot_telemetry sourcetype=lerobot:telemetry event_type=robot_step | mvexpand joint_violations | table _time episode step motor position min max | where isnotnull(motor) | sort -_time | head 10
index=lerobot_telemetry sourcetype=lerobot:telemetry event_type=robot_step | table _time gripper_position gripper_state | sort -_time | head 1
